title: Changing a customer's term in Edit Customer does not change QuickBooks
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop is connected to QuickBooks and changes a customer's term from Net 30 to Net 45 in Edit Customer.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The test organization is connected to a QuickBooks Online sandbox company, and you can sign in to that company in another tab.
  • Customer {Customer-A} holds Net 30 and is already in QuickBooks with terms Net 30; work order {Work-order-1} for it is complete.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S8-05 Customer and {Work-order-1} is S2-15444.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open Edit Customer for {Customer-A}.
  2. Choose "Net 45" in Credit Terms.
  3. Click Save.
  4. In QuickBooks, open the customer {Customer-A}.
  5. On {Work-order-1}'s Finance tab, click Create Invoice.
  6. Wait until the invoice has synced.
  7. In QuickBooks, open the invoice.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the window opens.
  • Step 2: the dropdown shows Net 45.
  • Step 3: the window closes and the customer is saved on Net 45.
  • Step 4: its terms still read Net 30.
  • Step 5: the invoice is created on Net 45.
  • Step 6: the invoice is no longer on the QB Unexported report.
  • Step 7: the invoice carries Net 45 and its own due date, while the QuickBooks customer still reads Net 30.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11677 (Story 8, QuickBooks sync - credit terms)

  • S8-R6: “Changing a customer's term in ShopView, by Edit Customer or by Move Customers (Story 4: Move Customers), does not change the customer record in QuickBooks, exactly as an Edit Customer save does not today. The QuickBooks customer keeps the term it was created with; new invoices still carry the right term.”
  • Out of Scope: “Updating the customer's term inside QuickBooks after it was created there. No such sync exists today; building one is new scope.”
